title: Six-axis arm (UR5e-class) · coordinated tape · joint angle per situation (sim)
source: pid-tuning/samples.json (UR5e, tape coordinated): situations target, factory, tuned; joints shoulder_lift and elbow

t.note: Seconds from the target's start (the clock). Each series is indexed by its own t0 at the tape's dt (0.01 s); shown every 0.02 s (50 Hz), decimated for display only: every metric is the producer's, on its own 100 Hz samples.

situation.note: target = the frozen tape; factory / analytic / tuned / oracle = pidtuna's four controller rungs replayed on it in simulation (none is a real robot).

joint.note: Joint name from the robot file.

q_deg.note: Joint angle of this situation, rad in the export, shown in degrees, rounded to 0.001°. Null past the series' own end (never held).

q_target_deg.note: The target's angle at the same t, degrees, rounded to 0.001°.

err_mrad.note: q − q_target, signed, from the export's radians (stored to 1 µrad), rounded to 0.001 mrad. Null on target rows: the target has no error against itself.
